Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished replacement cutscene illustration for the original game SORA CARS, chapter 3 introduction. This is a reference-guided redraw into a GENUINELY NEW camera viewpoint, not a crop, recolor, collage or reproduction of any supplied illustration.
OUTPUT: a single opaque PNG, landscape, EXACTLY 1672 pixels wide by 941 pixels high.
REFERENCE ROLES: inputs 1–2 establish Rei's small credit office, character faces and meticulous pixel-art style. Input 3 is ONLY the identity reference for Yui (yellow windbreaker, dark ponytail). Input 4 is ONLY the identity reference for Mei (denim jacket, long dark hair, film camera). Input 5 is the precise geometry reference for the SORA emblem. Do not reproduce the readable lettering or imperfect emblem glyphs in inputs 1–4; input 5 overrides their emblem designs.
CONTINUITY: rainy night, Japan in 1986, a small crowded wooden credit office, old wooden desk, green glass banker's lamp, files and ledgers, black rotary telephone, tall window with rain and modest 1986 city buildings outside. Amber/ivory lamplight against navy/violet shadow, tomato red and restrained mint highlights. No modern objects, no Skytree. Rei Sorashiro is a 29-year-old Japanese woman, the same tired honest face and small round metal spectacles as input 2, short dark hair swept and pinned back, grey waistcoat over pale blue blouse. Aki Soramoto is a 24-year-old Japanese woman mechanic with the exact jaw-length dark bob and face from input 1, white T-shirt and red mechanic coveralls tied at her waist. Mei Amaha is a 26-year-old Japanese woman photographer with long dark hair, denim jacket and analog film camera as input 4. Yui Utsugi is a 27-year-old Japanese woman engineer with dark ponytail and yellow windbreaker as input 3. Only include characters explicitly requested below. No Celeste Vale, no Toru Amamiya, no men, no boardroom.
STYLE: refined handcrafted late-1980s Japanese arcade 16-bit story art matching inputs 1–2, crisp visible square pixel clusters, deliberate stepped contours, nuanced clustered dithering and richly shaded limited palette. Not smooth anime painting, not photorealism. Natural anatomy, beautiful expressive acting and carefully drawn hands.
LAYOUT: all faces, hands, important props and the required emblem comfortably inside the upper 68% of the frame. The lower 30% (y=659 through 940) is an unobtrusive naturally dark navy desk-front/floor shadow with sparse pixel texture: no faces, hands, bright paper, graph, camera or important props in that zone. No hard blank letterbox, no border.
EMBLEM: draw the exact icon in input 5 as an organic part of ONE natural scene object specified below, centered horizontally AND vertically on that object's visible surface. It is a red circle with white geometric negative space: TWO EQUALLY LONG THICK PERFECTLY STRAIGHT horizontal bars, a short thick vertical central connection, two thick perfectly straight diagonal white channels descending from the lower bar and cutting completely THROUGH the circle's lower-left and lower-right circumference. Those two channels leave TWO OPEN GAPS at the bottom rim and a RED TRIANGULAR WEDGE between them. Exactly reproduce input 5's proportions. It is NOT a font character: never draw 天, never curve, taper or flare the diagonal channels, never enclose the bottom gaps inside a complete red ring. No surrounding words. Do not add other invented logos or emblem copies. The CROWN icon is instead a simple three-point crown silhouette with flat base, clearly unrelated to the SORA icon.
TEXT: absolutely NO readable text, Japanese characters, Latin letters, numbers, logos other than the requested geometric SORA and crown icons, captions, speech bubbles, subtitles, UI, watermark or borders. Documents may have only sparse indecipherable pen dashes; calculator buttons and spines have no legible characters. Dialogue is acting context only; never render dialogue.

CUT 8 — RIGHT: a genuinely new medium-wide camera viewpoint from the opposite side of the desk to cut 7, looking past Aki and Mei toward Rei. Rei faces camera at upper center/right, the same round metal spectacles, swept pinned-back short dark hair, pale blue blouse and grey waistcoat as input 2; her weary eyes and grave, guilty expression communicate responsibility. She holds up an open glossy cream tenant brochure at chest height with natural hands, showing the listeners a clear printed product illustration of a sleek BEIGE 1980s PAYMENT TERMINAL. The illustrated terminal is a bulky wedge-shaped plastic desktop unit with small dark green monochrome display, blank mechanical keys and paper receipt slot, no modern touchscreen. A small simple three-point crown symbol is printed on the terminal, distinct from the SORA emblem. Brochure is an image-led object with NO headings, words, letters or numbers, only the large terminal illustration and faint abstract layout lines.
Aki and Mei are together across the desk on the left in attentive three-quarter profile, faces visible: Aki exact short bob/white tee/red coveralls tied at waist; Mei long dark hair/denim jacket with film camera lowered against her chest and hands resting loosely on it. Mei must not be holding camera to her eye. No Yui needed in this angle. Green banker's lamp glows behind the brochure, wooden files and ledgers, an unnumbered rotary phone, and rain-streaked tall window establish the SAME small office at night.
Required SORA emblem placement: centered on a cream-colored closed folder propped upright on the desk between the listeners and Rei, facing the camera almost squarely. Its exact geometric red-and-white icon follows input 5, with open bottom gaps. Keep the emblem and entire folder unobscured, one icon only, no accompanying lettering.
CAMERA/FRAMING: a LOW eye-level camera with the far desktop at the HORIZONTAL MIDDLE of the picture. All heads, brochure, hands, camera and folder occupy the UPPER 60% of the frame. Brochure top is around y=250 and bottom around y=460; no hands below y=540. The desk's front edge runs across at y=580. The ENTIRE LOWER 35% shows only the large deep navy wooden desk front and soft floor shadow, no highlighted props or important visual information. This deliberate spacious composition is needed for game dialogue, but NEVER draw the dialogue or UI. Unreadable marks only on other papers; all dial holes and keys have no numerals.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input 1 is an almost finished 1672×941 pixel-art cutscene; input 2 is its emblem geometry reference. Output one opaque PNG at exactly 1672×941.
Make just TWO tiny localized corrections, retaining the complete composition, characters, hands, faces, rain, colors, objects, folder emblem and pixel clusters.
1. Mei's analog camera at the left of the folder has a silver top front nameplate with black letter-like marks. Remove those marks entirely, making that nameplate plain brushed silver without any name, letters, symbols or numbers. Keep all other camera features.
2. The beige payment terminal pictured in Rei's brochure has a tiny dark brand-like mark on its lower front surface. Remove this mark entirely. Make the front casing plain beige with no text. Preserve the crown icon on its side. Terminal keys are blank, screen empty.
Do not introduce any new words, letters, numbers, icons or logos. Leave the brochure's abstract layout bars as shapes. Preserve the centered exact red-and-white SORA icon on the cream folder, including equally long straight white bars and two open diagonal cutouts through the bottom red circle rim. Preserve the quiet dark lower 30%, no new objects there. No other changes.
